relationship_rules.name: Faster detection with fewer critical incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Faster detection coincides with fewer critical incidents, a consistent threat-response signal.

relationship_rules.name: Faster response with fewer critical incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Faster response coincides with fewer critical incidents, consistent with improving containment.

relationship_rules.name: MFA coverage and identity incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising MFA coverage coinciding with fewer identity incidents is a consistent identity-control improvement signal.

relationship_rules.name: MFA coverage and privileged violations
relationship_rules.interpretation: Higher MFA coverage with fewer privileged-access violations suggests stronger privileged-access protection.

relationship_rules.name: MFA coverage and account compromise
relationship_rules.interpretation: Higher MFA coverage with fewer account compromises is consistent with credential-attack resistance.

relationship_rules.name: EDR coverage and response time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader EDR coverage with faster response is consistent with improved endpoint visibility and containment.

relationship_rules.name: Detection coverage and detection time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader detection coverage coinciding with faster detection is consistent with improved visibility.

relationship_rules.name: EDR coverage and detection time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader EDR coverage coinciding with faster detection is consistent with improved endpoint visibility.

relationship_rules.name: Automation and response time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Higher automated-response rate with faster response is consistent with automation reducing handling time.

relationship_rules.name: Detection time and high-severity incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Faster detection coinciding with fewer high-severity incidents is a consistent positive signal.

relationship_rules.name: KEV exposure and remediation SLA
relationship_rules.interpretation: Fewer known-exploited vulnerabilities with improving remediation SLA is consistent with tightening exposure control.

relationship_rules.name: Critical backlog and staffing
relationship_rules.interpretation: A shrinking critical backlog alongside reduced headcount may reflect efficiency gains or reduced capacity; interpret with care.

relationship_rules.name: Patch compliance and critical vulnerabilities
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving critical-patch compliance with fewer critical vulnerabilities is consistent with effective patch discipline.

relationship_rules.name: Patch compliance and end-of-life assets
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving patch compliance with fewer end-of-life assets is consistent with reducing structural exposure.

relationship_rules.name: Secure config and configuration drift
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising secure-configuration compliance with falling drift is a consistent configuration-hygiene signal.

relationship_rules.name: Exposure score and internet-facing criticals
relationship_rules.interpretation: A falling exposure score with fewer internet-facing criticals is consistent with reduced external risk.

relationship_rules.name: RTO compliance and restore testing
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving RTO compliance with successful restore tests strengthens recovery assurance.

relationship_rules.name: RPO compliance and backup success
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving RPO compliance with reliable backups strengthens recovery-point assurance.

relationship_rules.name: Availability and DR exercise success
relationship_rules.interpretation: Strong availability with successful DR exercises is consistent with credible resilience.

relationship_rules.name: Cyber downtime and availability
relationship_rules.interpretation: Falling cyber downtime with rising availability is a consistent operational-resilience signal.

relationship_rules.name: Cyber downtime and material incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Falling downtime with fewer material incidents is consistent with reduced business impact.

relationship_rules.name: Immutable backups and ransomware
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising immutable-backup coverage with fewer ransomware incidents is consistent with improved ransomware resilience.

relationship_rules.name: Restore testing and ransomware
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving restore success with fewer ransomware incidents is consistent with credible recovery capability.

relationship_rules.name: Access lifecycle and dormant accounts
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving joiner-mover-leaver SLA with fewer dormant accounts is consistent with tighter access lifecycle control.

relationship_rules.name: Privileged reviews and excessive privilege
relationship_rules.interpretation: More complete privileged reviews with fewer excessive-privilege findings is a consistent least-privilege signal.

relationship_rules.name: Zero-trust coverage and account compromise
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader zero-trust coverage with fewer account compromises is consistent with reduced implicit trust.

relationship_rules.name: Risk-appetite breaches and residual risk
relationship_rules.interpretation: Falling risk-appetite breaches with lower residual risk is a consistent governance-improvement signal.

relationship_rules.name: Audit findings and control pass rate
relationship_rules.interpretation: Fewer overdue audit findings with a higher control pass rate is consistent with strengthening assurance.

relationship_rules.name: Regulatory findings and assurance coverage
relationship_rules.interpretation: Fewer regulatory findings with broader assurance coverage is consistent with a stronger control environment.

relationship_rules.name: Control testing and residual risk
relationship_rules.interpretation: A higher control pass rate with lower residual risk is consistent with effective controls.

relationship_rules.name: Risk-appetite breaches and open high-risk findings
relationship_rules.interpretation: Falling appetite breaches with fewer open high-risk findings is a consistent governance signal.

relationship_rules.name: Supplier assessment and supplier incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader supplier assessment with fewer third-party incidents is consistent with improved supply-chain visibility.

relationship_rules.name: Supplier concentration and high-risk findings
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising supplier concentration together with rising high-risk supplier findings is a compounding supply-chain risk signal.

relationship_rules.name: Supplier remediation and supplier incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving supplier remediation with fewer third-party incidents is consistent with effective supply-chain control.

relationship_rules.name: Third-party access and third-party incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Fewer third-party access accounts alongside fewer third-party incidents is consistent with reduced external access exposure.

relationship_rules.name: Awareness completion and phishing failure
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising awareness completion while phishing failure rises suggests a gap between compliance activity and behavioural effectiveness.

relationship_rules.name: Security culture and reporting rate
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving security culture with higher reporting is consistent with stronger human-layer detection.

relationship_rules.name: DLP coverage and DLP incidents
relationship_rules.interpretation: Irrespective of direction, DLP coverage and incident volume should be read together rather than in isolation.

relationship_rules.name: Cloud workload coverage and config compliance
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader cloud coverage with higher config compliance is consistent with maturing cloud security.

relationship_rules.name: Endpoint patch and policy compliance
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving endpoint patch and policy compliance together is consistent with stronger endpoint hygiene.

relationship_rules.name: Investment and MFA coverage
relationship_rules.interpretation: Increased security investment coinciding with broader MFA coverage is consistent with investment translating into control coverage.

relationship_rules.name: Investment and EDR coverage
relationship_rules.interpretation: Increased security investment coinciding with broader EDR coverage is consistent with investment translating into visibility.

relationship_rules.name: Investment and response time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Increased security investment coinciding with faster response is consistent with investment improving capability.

relationship_rules.name: Investment and critical backlog
relationship_rules.interpretation: Increased security investment coinciding with a shrinking critical backlog is consistent with investment reducing exposure.

relationship_rules.name: Investment without evident outcome
relationship_rules.interpretation: Increased security investment alongside rising critical incidents raises an investment-effectiveness question, not proof of poor management.

relationship_rules.name: Security spend and control pass rate
relationship_rules.interpretation: Higher relative security spend with a higher control pass rate is consistent with effective allocation of investment.

relationship_rules.name: Programme completion and maturity
relationship_rules.interpretation: Higher programme completion with rising maturity is consistent with a programme translating into capability.

relationship_rules.name: Initiative delivery and programme completion
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improved initiative delivery with higher programme completion is consistent with execution momentum.

relationship_rules.name: Maturity and control pass rate
relationship_rules.interpretation: Rising maturity with a higher control pass rate is consistent with durable control improvement.

relationship_rules.name: Availability and response time
relationship_rules.interpretation: Improving availability with faster response is consistent with a resilient operating posture.

relationship_rules.name: Detection coverage and alert volume
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader detection coverage with higher alert volume may reflect improved visibility rather than a worsening threat; interpret with care.

relationship_rules.name: Sensitive-data discovery and encryption
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader sensitive-data discovery with higher encryption coverage is consistent with maturing data protection.

relationship_rules.name: Segmentation and ransomware
relationship_rules.interpretation: Broader segmentation with fewer ransomware incidents is consistent with improved containment.
